# TrailFold checkout-abandonment flow draft — email only, no discount

## Observations from supplied data
- Current 30 days: 25,000 sessions, 500 orders, $45,000 net product revenue. AOV = 45,000 / 500 = $90.
- Previous 30 days: 20,000 sessions, 600 orders, $54,000. AOV = 54,000 / 600 = $90. Conversion fell from 600/20,000 = 3.0% to 500/25,000 = 2.0%.
- Checkout-started sessions current = 1,000; orders = 500. Session-based checkout completion = 500/1,000 = 50%. Add-to-cart = 2,000; cart-to-checkout = 1,000/2,000 = 50%. This flow can only address the 1,000 checkout starters, not the 1,000 add-to-cart sessions that never reached checkout.
- Mobile current: 20,000 sessions / 300 orders = 1.5% conversion. Previous: 15,000 / 400 = 2.67%. Desktop current: 5,000 / 200 = 4.0%. Mobile orders fell by 100 while mobile sessions rose by 5,000; desktop was flat. Hypothesis: mobile and cart-to-checkout friction matter more than checkout-email copy alone. Missing: GA4, session recordings, field Core Web Vitals, SKU ad cost, incrementality.
- Support tickets last 30 days: 42 delivery-date, 28 15-inch-laptop, 18 waterproof. Fit plus rain questions = 46 of 88 = 52.3% of these tickets. These are the objections to answer.
- No discount is approved. Free US shipping is already policy, so it is not a new checkout-stage incentive; do not invent a free-shipping offer. Any future discount needs owner approval.
- Klaviyo attributed revenue is $14,000 currently on a 5-day click + 5-day open window that overlaps other systems, with no holdout. Treat it as directional, not incremental.

## Flow setup
Trigger: Checkout Started. Verify the actual Klaviyo metric name; a template labelled abandoned cart may fire on checkout started. Do not use Added to Cart as the trigger for this flow.

Purchase suppression: flow filter Placed Order zero times since starting this flow; exit condition on Placed Order. If the Shopify Klaviyo metric is available, exit immediately when an order is placed after Email 1.

Re-entry suppression: Has not been in this flow in last 7 days as a starting point. Test 3 vs 7 vs 14 days; shorter risks over-messaging, longer risks missing a restarted checkout.

Consent eligibility: send only to profiles with email consent and can receive email marketing. Checkout abandonment is marketing email, not transactional. If no email is captured, no send. This draft is email-only. If SMS is added later, use only one SMS per abandonment event, within 48 hours, with separate SMS consent and quiet hours.

Flow collision: checkout flow outranks campaigns and welcome for 24–48 hours. Exclude active checkout-abandonment profiles from non-essential campaigns during that window; do not rely on Smart Sending. If an Added to Cart flow exists, it should exit anyone who starts checkout; checkout flow then handles the later, higher-intent event. Purchase exits both. If a welcome flow is running, do not suppress the checkout email solely because a welcome email sent recently; checkout intent is higher. If a campaign is scheduled, suppress the campaign for in-flow profiles.

## Email 1 — 30–60 minutes after checkout started
Subject: Your TrailFold checkout is still open

Body:
Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},
You started checkout for your TrailFold order but didn't finish. We saved it here: [Complete your order].
A few plain facts:
- Free US shipping. Delivery estimate is 4–7 business days.
- 30-day returns for unused products; return shipping is paid by the customer.
- Daypack 18L has a padded 13-inch laptop sleeve. We cannot confirm a 15-inch laptop fits.
No discount code. Just your cart.
— TrailFold

## Email 2 — 24 hours after Email 1
Subject: Did checkout give you trouble?

Body:
Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},
It's [Founder name] at TrailFold. I saw you started checkout and didn't finish. No pressure — I wanted to check whether something got in the way.
Common questions we get:
- When will it arrive? Free US shipping, checkout estimate 4–7 business days. Tracking will show the exact date after it ships.
- Will a 15-inch laptop fit? Daypack 18L is built around a padded 13-inch sleeve. We have no verified 15-inch fit, so I can't promise it. If 15-inch carry is essential, this may not be the right bag.
- Is it waterproof? No. The fabric is water-resistant, not waterproof. It is not a rain shell.
If you want help deciding, reply. Your cart: [Complete your order].
— [Founder name], TrailFold

## Email 3 — 24 hours after Email 2
Subject: Straight answers: shipping, fit, rain

Body:
Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},
We don't have a discount to offer. We'd rather give you the facts before you buy.
- Shipping: free to US addresses. Delivery estimate 4–7 business days. If you need it by a specific date, order with buffer; we cannot guarantee a date.
- Fit: 18L capacity, external bottle pocket, padded 13-inch laptop sleeve. It is not designed around a 15-inch laptop, and we cannot confirm 15-inch fit.
- Rain: water-resistant fabric, not waterproof. No waterproof claim.
- Returns: 30 days for unused products; customer pays return shipping.
If those terms work: [Complete your order]. If they don't, reply and we'll help you decide — including telling you not to buy if the bag is wrong for you.
— TrailFold

## QA steps
- Verify the trigger is Checkout Started, not Added to Cart. In Klaviyo > Metrics, confirm Checkout Started exists and whether Added to Cart exists. The supplied account shows only welcome and checkout abandonment flows; no Added to Cart flow is listed. That is a gap but outside this three-email scope.
- Add flow filters: Placed Order zero times since starting this flow; Has not been in this flow in last 7 days. Confirm email consent and can receive email marketing. Add exit condition on Placed Order.
- Test end-to-end with internal profiles: start checkout, confirm Email 1 after 45 minutes; place order, confirm no further sends; unsubscribe, confirm suppression; no email consent, confirm no send; active in welcome/campaign, confirm collision rule.
- Check dynamic product block and cart link render the correct abandoned item(s), on mobile and desktop. Enable UTM tracking. Confirm reply-to address and plain-text founder email.
- Claim check: no waterproof, no 15-inch fit, no lifetime durability, no competitor performance, no fabricated reviews or testimonials. Use only 13-inch sleeve, water-resistant not waterproof, free US shipping, 4–7 business days, 30-day unused returns, customer-paid return shipping.
- Post-launch: monitor placed-order rate, checkout-started-to-order rate, unsubscribe, spam complaints, and revenue per recipient. Compare to holdout if possible. Current Klaviyo attribution uses overlapping windows and has no holdout, so treat it as directional, not incremental.

No deployment is possible here; this is a copy and configuration draft.
questions: Can you confirm the exact Klaviyo metric or trigger name available in the account for checkout started, and whether an Added to Cart flow exists or should be built in parallel? This determines whether the checkout flow is the only abandonment flow or part of a two-flow build.
Should this remain email-only, or do you want a matching SMS variant? If SMS, I need SMS consent status and will draft one SMS per abandonment event within 48 hours.
Who should sign the plain-text check-in, and what reply-to or support address should it use? I used [Founder name] because no verified founder name was supplied.
assumptions: Klaviyo and Shopify integration can fire Checkout Started and apply the filters described; exact UI names may differ.
Dynamic product block can show the abandoned Daypack 18L or other cart item.
Email consent data is accurate; checkout abandonment is treated as marketing email.
No discount is included in this draft; any future discount requires owner approval.
The only allowed fit and rain claims are padded 13-inch laptop sleeve and water-resistant-not-waterproof. No 15-inch fit or waterproof claim is made.
Founder name and reply-to are placeholders.
No Added to Cart flow exists currently, based on the supplied Klaviyo flow list showing welcome and checkout abandonment only; if it exists, collision rules apply.
Re-entry suppression of 7 days is a starting point, not a proven optimum.
